name: cumulative spend: only the same agent, the same currency and the last 30 days count, and only above the ceiling
notes: muse: ceiling 5000 USD. chatgpt: no ceiling. There is no coverage at all, so no eligible interval overlaps any window → coverage 'none' for every claim (§6.1; the v1.3 no-parser cap only lowers coverage to partial, never raises it), and a claim that no ceiling rule catches is no_coverage.
priorSpendCents (§6.3) = Σ amountCents of the same agent's spend-type claims in the claim's currency with claimedAt in [t − 30 d, t] and strictly before the claim.
c1 muse 3000 USD at 09-06 09:59:59.999: prior 0 → no ceiling rule → no_coverage; FINAL (§8): evaluatedAt ≥ end(09-06 10:00) + 24 h.

c2 muse 3000 EUR at 10-06 09:00: amountAboveCeiling (§6.1 v1.3): an amount is known (the claim's), the claim's EUR amount does not count toward the Amount (only an absent currency or spendCurrency counts), so nothing exceeds the ceiling, but the claim's currency is present and ≠ spendCurrency → true, reason ceiling.currency_mismatch alone {currency: EUR (the claim's), spendCurrency: USD} → rule over_ceiling, FINAL at once (claim-only).
c3 chatgpt 3000 USD at 10-06 09:30: no ceiling → no_coverage, PENDING until 10-07 09:31.

c4 muse 3000 USD at 10-06 10:00: window [09-06 10:00, 10-06 10:00]. c1 is 1 ms before its start (excluded), c2 is EUR (excluded), c3 is chatgpt's (excluded) → prior 0; 0 + 3000 ≤ 5000 → no_coverage, PENDING. Counting any of them would give 6000 > 5000.
c5 muse 2000 USD at 10-06 10:30: prior = c4's 3000 → 3000 + 2000 = 5000, not > 5000 → no_coverage, PENDING (the ceiling itself is allowed).
c6 muse 1 cent USD at 10-06 11:00: prior = c4 3000 + c5 2000 = 5000 → 5001 > 5000 → rule over_ceiling_cumulative, reason ceiling.cumulative_exceeded, FINAL at once (claim-only).
No observations: every receipt has match.none.
